title: Telepathic contact with the orb 'Sylvia'
summary: Jordan Jose tells of Telepathic contact with the orb 'Sylvia', about c. 2008–2010 at Baker Victory Services, Western New York, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Baker Victory Services, Western New York

tellings.quote: fractalizing type energy. And in one of the experiences, it was telling me that his name was Sylvia.

plain: A man named Jordan Jose, speaking on the podcast of host Jesse Michels, says that between about 2008 and 2010, at a place called Baker Victory Services in Western New York, he had mind-to-mind contact with a glowing ball of light, which he calls an orb. He describes its energy as branching and repeating, like a fractal, and says that during one of these experiences it told him its name was Sylvia. If true, it would mean a non-human presence could talk directly to a person's mind.
